messages:
alex hong: Hey team :wave: I just started today — trying to bootstrap my M1 Mac. Running into weird issues with asdf, brew paths, and npm native deps. Anyone who’s done the setup recently?
liz chen: Welcome Alex! :tada: What specific errors are you seeing? M1/Homebrew path stuff is the usual suspect.
alex hong: Thanks! Main problem is installing ruby/node via asdf — build fails saying can't find openssl or libssl. Brew is installed at /opt/homebrew.
samir: For openssl on Apple Silicon I usually do: `brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config` then point env vars when installing with asdf.
emma roberts: Paste these in your shell before `asdf install` if using ruby/node native builds: ```export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"```
alex hong: OK that helped the openssl step. Now asdf won't pick up the right node plugin — it still uses old system node. My PATH shows /usr/local/bin before /opt/homebrew/bin.
liz chen: On ARM brew is under /opt/homebrew. Make sure you have `eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"` in your ~/.zprofile (for zsh) so PATH is set early. We put it at the top of zprofile in our dotfiles.
infra-bot: deploy-helpers: Reminder: for new macs we also require Rosetta for some x86 binaries: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` (if you hit an x86-only build).
alex hong: Ah got it. After putting brew shellenv in zprofile and restarting terminal asdf now detects the correct node versions. One more: ssh key and dotfiles — where do I push my public key and how to get org dotfiles?
dev-support: Add your public key to the team repo under `infrastructure/ssh-keys` and create a PR, or ping @liz for a quick add. Dotfiles are in our private dotfiles repo — you should have invite link in the onboarding doc. If not, DM me.
alex hong: I couldn't find the onboarding doc link in the welcome email. Can someone resend?
emma roberts: Sent you the invite link and added your key just now :thumbsup: Also FYI we use ~/.local/bin for some helpers — add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` after the brew shellenv.
samir: One more tip: for asdf plugins: `asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git` then run `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` before installing node (for PGP).
alex hong: That fixed node plugin. All green now — installed ruby, node, yarn. Thanks everyone!
liz chen: Nice :rocket: If you hit anything else ping #devex or @dev-support. Also post any small fixes back to onboarding doc so we can keep it updated.
alex hong: Will do. Appreciate the help!
